title: Handle AR interruption and app suspension
acceptance: No cached depth after interruption; Pi expires observations and recovery needs fresh data.
evidence: ios/Lifecycle: Swift lifecycle guard, ARKit/UIKit forwarding bridge and integration guide. 10 core XCTest cases pass with Swift 6.0.3 on Linux; Apple bridge and its 2 tests excluded on Linux.
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 113 passed, including 3 CS-017 consumer expiry/reconnect regressions.
blocker: Software package prepared; CS-016 host transport integration, verified device clock mapping, Xcode/Apple bridge build and real LiDAR phone-to-Pi interruption/suspension acceptance remain pending. No device or motor readiness claimed.
